decisions.reason: The source impact is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY covering platform height, supported cup size, and edge-to-edge mixer fit.
The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY recording the raised base as a custom-fabricated exception to the off-the-shelf policy; no further state change is required.
The base dimensions and cup-clearance constraints do not change the approved component set, BOM status, or existing component-selection obligations.
The mechanical dimensions of the separate raised base do not entail any change to the finalized electrical wiring-plan deliverable.
The source specifies platform height, cup clearance, and mixer fit without changing bowl capacity, bowl form, or bowl-size reference.
Providing clearance beneath the existing spouts does not change their geometry, orientation, construction, appearance, or beverage-quality constraints.
The source message establishes dimensions and fit only; the platform color and font-color requirements were established separately in message 128 and remain unchanged.
The raised base and cup-clearance dimensions do not alter bowl removal, swapping, cleaning access, or clearance from the whisk and motor assembly.
The source does not mention or change machine wording, placard placement, placard sides, or branding.
The platform's height and footprint do not necessarily change the existing splash-control target or its mitigation options.
An edge-to-edge fit between the mixer and raised base is a structural layout constraint and does not modify the established DJ-style visual identity.
The source concerns a separate platform beneath the mixer; it does not change sealing or leak-prevention requirements for the machine's internal base and electronics.
